ex.en: Under the new treaty, the country agreed to reduce its nuclear arsenal.
ex.zh: 根据新条约，该国同意削减其核武器库。

ex.en: The police confirmed that the warehouse fire was a case of arson.
ex.zh: 警方证实，仓库大火系人为纵火。

senses: n. 艺术；艺术作品；艺术技巧

ex.en: Critics disagree about whether graffiti should be treated as art or as vandalism.
ex.zh: 关于涂鸦应被视为艺术还是破坏行为，评论家们意见不一。

artery.usage: 派生arterial adj.动脉的,像动脉的

ex.en: A blocked artery can seriously reduce the flow of blood to the heart.
ex.zh: 动脉堵塞会严重减少流向心脏的血液。

senses: n. [C] 文章；条款；物件；冠词
article.usage: 辨析:article报刊文章;essay文学哲学论文;paper供朗读的论文;thesis毕业/学位论文

ex.en: She published an article questioning the methodology behind the widely cited study.
ex.zh: 她发表了一篇文章，质疑这项被广泛引用的研究背后的方法论。

senses: adj. 发音清晰的,善于表达的
adj. 善于表达的；口齿清楚的
v. 清晰明白地说(或表达)
articulate.usage: art(i)(艺术)+cul(培养)+ate(动词后缀)→培养说话的艺术，用艺术的语言把东西表达出来→善于表达的；索引p403

ex.en: She is remarkably articulate and can defend her views under sharp questioning.
ex.zh: 她口齿伶俐、善于表达，能在尖锐的提问下为自己的观点辩护。

ex.en: The chairman articulated the company's new strategy in a single clear sentence.
ex.zh: 主席用一句清晰的话阐明了公司的新战略。

ex.en: Frustrated children often struggle to articulate what they actually feel.
ex.zh: 受挫的儿童常常难以清楚说出自己的真实感受。

senses: n. 人工制品，手工艺品（尤指有历史或文化价值的）
n. (尤指有历史或文化价值的)手工艺品
artifact.usage: art（艺术）+i+fact（做）→做出来的艺术品→人工制品；手工艺品

ex.en: The museum acquired an ancient artifact that sheds light on early farming communities.
ex.zh: 博物馆收藏了一件古代人工制品，为了解早期农耕社会提供了线索。

senses: n. 人工制品,手工艺品(尤指有历史或文化价值的)

ex.en: Each artifact unearthed at the site was photographed and catalogued within a week.
ex.zh: 遗址出土的每一件手工艺品都在一周内完成了拍摄和编目。

senses: adj. 人造的；人工的；虚假的
a. 人造的；人工的；虚假的
artificial.usage: [近] synthetic a. 合成的；man-made a. 人造的；同义:man-made,synthetic,false;反义genuine；助记:arti(艺术品)+fic(制作)+ial→人造的；art（技巧）+i（我）+fic（做）+ial（……的）→我用技巧做出来的；词根记忆：arti+fic(make

ex.en: DeepMind is one of the leading artificial intelligence (AI) companies in the world.
ex.zh: 深度思考（DeepMind）是全球人工智能的头部企业之一。

ex.en: artificial intelligence
ex.zh: 人工智能

ex.en: an artificial smile
ex.zh: 假笑

artist.usage: 助记:art(艺术)+ist(表示人)→艺术家

ex.en: The artist refused to sell the painting, insisting that it belonged to the public.
ex.zh: 这位艺术家拒绝出售这幅画，坚称它属于公众。

senses: adj. 艺术(家)的,美术(家)的;有艺术技巧的
artistic.usage: 记：art（艺术）+-istic（形容词后缀）→艺术的

ex.en: The city's artistic heritage attracts millions of visitors from abroad every year.
ex.zh: 这座城市的艺术遗产每年吸引数百万海外游客。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

senses: n. (书、刊中的)插图;艺术作品

ex.en: The gallery's latest artwork acquisition attracted considerable public attention.
ex.zh: 该美术馆最新购入的艺术品引起了公众的广泛关注。

senses: 表有……性质的，形容词词性

ex.en: The suffix '-ary' forms adjectives such as 'contrary' and 'documentary'.
ex.zh: 后缀 -ary 构成形容词，如 contrary（相反的）和 documentary（文件的）。

as.usage: 词组as a whole总的来说;as for至于,就……方面说;as though好像,仿佛;as to至于,关于;as follows如下

ex.en: As the population ages, demand for healthcare services will continue to rise.
ex.zh: 随着人口老龄化，对医疗服务的需求将持续上升。

senses: v. 登高,(渐渐)上升,升高
ascend.usage: 助记:a(to为了)+scend(climb爬)→爬上→攀登；v.攀登；上升；晋升；a（一再）+scend（=climb爬，攀）→一再地攀爬往上走→升高

ex.en: The plane took off and ascended steadily until it was out of sight.
ex.zh: 飞机起飞之后平稳地逐渐升空直到消失在视野之中。

ex.en: The hikers ascended the mountain before sunrise to watch the view.
ex.zh: 徒步者们在日出前登上山顶观赏景色。

ex.en: The balloon slowly ascended above the clouds.
ex.zh: 气球缓缓升到了云层之上。

ascertain.usage: 34 "查明、证书"相关词汇；as（表示"加强"）+certain（确信，必然的）→一再地确信→查明，弄清楚

ex.en: Investigators tried to ascertain whether the bridge had been inspected before the collapse.
ex.zh: 调查人员试图查明大桥在坍塌前是否经过检查。

senses: vt. （ascribe sth. to sb.）把某事归因于某人
vt. 认为…具有；把…归因于
ascribe.usage: v.把……归因于；认是……的特点；a（=ad，去）+scribe（写、刻）→写入其中→归入其中→把……归因于；索引p403

ex.en: They ascribe this achievement to that man.
ex.zh: 他们把这一成就归功于那个人。

ex.en: Many historians ascribe the country's rapid economic growth to its long-term investment in education and infrastructure.
ex.zh: 许多历史学家将该国的经济快速增长归因于其在教育和基础设施上的长期投资。

ex.en: The report ascribes the decline in bird populations to the widespread use of chemical pesticides on farms.
ex.zh: 该报告将鸟类数量的下降归因于农场广泛使用化学杀虫剂。

ex.en: The volcano covered the nearby villages in a thick layer of ash.
ex.zh: 火山使附近的村庄覆盖上厚厚的一层火山灰。

senses: adj. 惭愧的,羞耻的,害臊的
ashamed.usage: 只作表语。；助记:a+shamed(丢脸的)→惭愧的,羞耻的

ex.en: He was deeply ashamed of having ignored the warning signs for so long.
ex.zh: 他为自己长期忽视预警信号而深感羞愧。

ashore.usage: 反义:aboard adv.在船(或飞机或车)上

ex.en: The fishermen struggled to pull their damaged boat ashore before the storm struck.
ex.zh: 渔民们奋力在暴风雨来临前把受损的船拖上岸。

asia.usage: 附录Ⅱ 大洲名；形容词 Asian

ex.en: Asia has become the main engine of global economic growth.
ex.zh: 亚洲已成为全球经济增长的主要引擎。

ex.en: Asian economies now account for a growing share of international trade.
ex.zh: 亚洲经济体如今在国际贸易中所占的份额日益增大。

phrases.m: 把…暂放一边；把…留作后用

aside.usage: 联想记忆：a+side(一边)→到旁边；aside from 除…之外；索引p403

ex.en: He stepped aside to let the ambulance pass through the crowded street.
ex.zh: 他闪身让到一旁，让救护车穿过拥挤的街道。

ex.en: Joking aside, the board must now deal with the budget deficit.
ex.zh: 玩笑归玩笑，董事会现在必须处理预算赤字问题。

ex.en: She sets aside a small sum each month for her daughter's education.
ex.zh: 她每月留出一小笔钱作女儿的教育费用。

ex.en: Visitors are asked to leave large bags in the lockers at the entrance.
ex.zh: 请参观者把大件包裹寄存在入口处的储物柜里。

senses: a. 睡着的；（手臂或腿）麻木的

ex.en: Half of the audience fell asleep during the overly technical presentation.
ex.zh: 在过于专业化的报告中，一半听众都睡着了。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

senses: adj. 不喜社交的,不合群的
asocial.usage: adj.自私的；不合群的；缺乏 社交性的；索引p403

ex.en: Constant remote work may encourage asocial habits among employees.
ex.zh: 长期远程办公可能助长员工的孤僻习惯。

ex.en: The novelist led an asocial life, avoiding parties and public events.
ex.zh: 这位小说家过着不合群的生活，回避聚会和公开活动。

ex.en: Teachers noticed that the boy's asocial behaviour preceded his academic decline.
ex.zh: 老师们注意到，这个男孩的孤僻行为先于他学业上的退步出现。

aspect.usage: n.方面;方位；外表，外观 该chairman 得到了很多bankers 的支持。与他人contrast，他认为所有人以colleague 的身份在共同的 circumstance 中engaged in 工作是crucial 的。Mean；n.方面；朝向；外观；a（一个）+spect（看）→只看一眼只能了解事物的一个

ex.en: The exhibition will focus on various aspects of life and culture in the Middle East.
ex.zh: 该展览将侧重于中东生活和文化的各个方面。

ex.en: Every aspect of the proposal was examined before parliament voted on it.
ex.zh: 在议会表决之前，提案的方方面面都经过了审查。

ex.en: The training course covers the legal aspects of running a small business.
ex.zh: 培训课程涵盖经营小企业所涉及的法律方面。

ex.en: The dining room has a southern aspect, so it stays warm all winter.
ex.zh: 餐厅朝南，所以整个冬天都很暖和。

ex.en: It also sent a clear message to the outside world about his aspirations.
ex.zh: 这也向外界发出了一个关于他抱负的明确信息。

ex.en: They transform the aspirations of the people who live there; they nudge the self-image of the city into a bolder and more optimistic light.
ex.zh: 它们改变了当地居民的抱负；它们把城市的形象推向了更勇敢无畏、更积极乐观的样子。

senses: v. 渴望（成就）；有志（成为）
aspire.usage: 派生aspiration n.志向,志趣,抱负;渴望；v.渴望，有志于；索引p403

ex.en: He aspired to be their next leader.
ex.zh: 他渴望成为他们的下一届领导人。

ex.en: Many graduates aspire to careers in law, medicine or finance.
ex.zh: 许多毕业生渴望从事法律、医疗或金融职业。

ex.en: The small club aspires to reach the top division within five years.
ex.zh: 这家小俱乐部立志五年内打入顶级联赛。

ex.en: She has aspired to a life of public service since leaving school.
ex.zh: 自离开学校起，她就一直向往投身公共事业。

senses: adj. 有抱负的，有志向的

ex.en: The workshop offers practical advice for aspiring novelists.
ex.zh: 该研讨会为有抱负的小说家提供实用建议。

ex.en: The plot to assassinate the president was uncovered by intelligence officers.
ex.zh: 刺杀总统的阴谋被情报人员挫败。

assault.usage: 辨析: assault 突然猛烈进攻,暗示武力直接接触; attack 常用词,各种形式攻击; assail 猛烈连续攻击; charge 冲锋式攻击; beset 围攻; 反义: protection；索引p403

ex.en: The report described a sharp increase in assaults on hospital staff.
ex.zh: 报告描述了针对医院工作人员的袭击急剧增加。

ex.en: The army launched an assault on the enemy's fortified positions at dawn.
ex.zh: 拂晓时分，部队向敌人的防御阵地发起了进攻。

ex.en: Critics saw the new tax as an assault on the middle class.
ex.zh: 批评者将新税视为对中产阶级的打击。

senses: v. 集合，聚集；组装，装配
assemble.usage: assembly 集会；装配。；同义: gather; 反义: dissolve；v.(使)集合，(使)聚集；装配， 组装；as（表示加强）+sem（联想成 same 一样的）+ble→把一样的人都聚集到一起→聚集；索引p403

ex.en: We had assembled for the first rehearsal.
ex.zh: 我们集合起来进行第一次排练。

ex.en: Workers assemble the car's main parts on a moving line, which greatly raises efficiency and lowers costs.
ex.zh: 工人们在流动的装配线上组装汽车的主要部件，这大大提高了效率并降低了成本。

ex.en: Senior officials from twelve nations assembled in Geneva to discuss measures against climate change.
ex.zh: 来自十二个国家的资深官员齐聚日内瓦，讨论应对气候变化的措施。

assembly.usage: [记] as-（加强意义）+sembl（相同）+-y（名词后缀）→许多人出于某个相同目的聚集在一起所开的会→集会。[近] gathering, meeting n. 集会；索引p403

ex.en: The car plant has fully automated its assembly line.
ex.zh: 这家汽车厂已使其装配线完全自动化。

ex.en: The whole school attended an assembly to celebrate the founding day.
ex.zh: 全校师生参加了庆祝建校日的集会。

ex.en: Careless mistakes during assembly can lead to serious product failures.
ex.zh: 装配过程中的疏忽可能导致严重的产品故障。

senses: v. 肯定地说(出),坚定地断言
assert.usage: assertion 断言。；辨析: assert 主观自信地断言、声称,正式用语; affirm 断言、肯定某看法; state 客观或正式地声明、陈述; declare 宣布、宣称,带官方意味; announce 宣布消息或事件; 反义: deny；as（表示加强）+sert（加入，插入）→一再地插入观点→断言。；辨

ex.en: The Administration was in essence asserting that because it didn't want to carry out Congress's immigration wishes, no state should be allowed to do so either.
ex.zh: 实际上，政府声称：因为它不想执行国会的移民意愿，所以其他州也不应被允许执行。

ex.en: The professor asserted that bilingual children often perform better in tasks requiring flexible thinking.
ex.zh: 这位教授断言，双语儿童在需要灵活思维的任务中往往表现更好。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

ex.en: His assertion that the data were fabricated was later proved wrong.
ex.zh: 他关于数据系伪造的断言后来被证明是错误的。

ex.en: The report's central assertion is that remote work boosts productivity.
ex.zh: 该报告的核心论断是远程办公能提高生产率。

ex.en: Scientists demand evidence before accepting any bold assertion.
ex.zh: 科学家在接受任何大胆断言之前都要求提供证据。

ex.en: Being assertive at work helps you express your ideas without causing conflict.
ex.zh: 在工作中坚定自信，有助于在不引发冲突的情况下表达自己的想法。

assess.usage: assessment 评估。；族：assessment n. 评估；估价。近义：evaluate vt. 评估；辨析:assess指确定某物确切价值并据此评定;estimate指个人推理作大致判断,并非绝对客观;evaluate指以等价物对价值作确定无疑的判断；v.评价，评定；估计；串词记忆:进入(access)系统进

ex.en: Unfortunately, the long-term costs of using simple quantitative metrics to assess researcher merit are likely to be quite great.
ex.zh: 不幸的是,使用简单的定量指标来评估研究人员的优点的长期成本可能相当高。

ex.en: It is hard, the state argues, for judges to assess the implications of new and rapidly changing technologies.
ex.zh: 该州认为，法官很难评估快速变化的新技术的影响。

phrases.p: the assessment of an applicant's papers
phrases.m: 对申请人的论文进行评估

assessment.usage: assess 的派生词；n.评估，评价；估价，估计；n.评估，评价；估价；索引p403

ex.en: The teacher's assessment of each pupil combines coursework with final exams.
ex.zh: 老师对每个学生的评估兼顾平时功课和期末考试。

ex.en: An independent assessment put the cost of repairs at two million dollars.
ex.zh: 一项独立评估估计维修费用为两百万美元。

ex.en: Investors are waiting for a fresh assessment of the company's prospects.
ex.zh: 投资者正等待对公司前景的最新评估。

senses: n. 优点，有价值的人/物
n. 有用的资源,宝贵的人(或物),有价值的人(或事物)
n. 资产，财产；有用的人（或事物）
asset.usage: 助记:as(表示强调)+set(放置)→放置的财产→资产；as(加强)+set(一套)→有一套房子→资产；索引p403

ex.en: Data is becoming an asset which needs to be guarded as much as any other asset.
ex.zh: 数据正在成为一种资产，需要像保护其他资产一样加以保护。

ex.en: Merrill Lynch got legal protection for an asset allocation strategy.
ex.zh: 美林证券公司的资产分配策略获得了法律保护。

ex.en: Her fluency in three languages proved a great asset when the company expanded into European markets.
ex.zh: 当公司拓展欧洲市场时，她流利掌握三种语言被证明是一大优势。

senses: v. 委派，指派；分配，布置
assign.usage: assignment 任务；作业。；辨析:assign分派工作;allot将定量东西分若干份;allocate正式用词,为特殊目的拨给；as（加强）+sign（信号）→一再给人信号让人做事→分配；词根记忆：as(to,给)+sign(示意)→示意给某人→布置（任务）；索引p403

ex.en: The teacher assigned each of the children a different task.
ex.zh: 老师给每个孩子都布置了不同的作业。

ex.en: No homework should be assigned that students cannot complete on their own.
ex.zh: 不应该布置一些学生不能独立完成的作业。

ex.en: Each new employee is assigned a mentor who offers guidance during the first six months of work.
ex.zh: 每位新员工都会被指派一名导师，在工作头六个月提供指导。

assignment.usage: 助记:assign(分配,委派)+ment(名词后缀)→分配,委派；n.作业，任务；分配，指派；索引p403

ex.en: The reporter's first foreign assignment was to cover the peace talks.
ex.zh: 这位记者的第一个驻外任务是报道和谈。

ex.en: Students must hand in their written assignments by Friday noon.
ex.zh: 学生必须在周五中午前交书面作业。

ex.en: Each member of the team knew exactly his assignment for the expedition.
ex.zh: 探险队的每个成员都清楚自己的具体任务。

assimilate.usage: 近义：absorb vt. 吸收；v.融入，同化；吸收，理解；使 相似；as（表示加强）+simil（相似）+ate（动词后缀）→使相似→（使）同化；索引p403

ex.en: We are obliged to them because some of these languages have since vanished, as the peoples who spoke them died out or became assimilated and lost their native languages.
ex.zh: 我们得感激他们，因为从此以后这些语言中有一些消失了，这是由于讲这些语言的部族要么灭绝了，要么被同化而丧失了自己的本族语言。

ex.en: Immigrant children tend to assimilate into the local culture far faster than their parents do.
ex.zh: 移民儿童往往比他们的父母快得多地融入当地文化。

ex.en: Students need time to assimilate the new concepts before they can apply them to real problems.
ex.zh: 学生需要时间消化新概念，然后才能把它们应用到实际问题中。

assimilation.usage: 词根记忆：as(near, 差不多)+simil(same, 相同)+ation(名词后缀)→几乎相同→同化；索引p403

ex.en: But they show comprehension to consist not just of passive assimilation but of active engagement in inference and problem-solving.
ex.zh: 但是它们（指阅读方式）表明理解不仅包括被动地吸收信息，也包括主动推理和解决问题。

ex.en: The assimilation of immigrants into the labour market varies across cities.
ex.zh: 移民融入劳动力市场的程度因城市而异。

ex.en: Learning depends on the assimilation of new ideas into existing knowledge.
ex.zh: 学习有赖于将新观念吸收进已有知识之中。

ex.en: The city's assimilative capacity has allowed successive waves of immigrants to integrate smoothly.
ex.zh: 这座城市的同化能力使一批批移民得以顺利融入。

assist.usage: assistance 帮助；assistant 助手。；辨析:assist指受协助的人自己能做一部分工作;aid指(尤其用金钱)援助一群人；v.帮助，协助 n.助攻；资助，帮助；v./n.帮助，协助；as（表示“一再地”）+sist（站）→一再地站在你旁边，准备帮助你→帮助；词根记忆：as(near, 近)+sist(

ex.en: He assists Professor Williams with his teaching.
ex.zh: 他协助威廉姆斯教授进行教学。

ex.en: Finding ways to assist this growing homeless population has become increasingly difficult.
ex.zh: 寻找方法来帮助日益庞大的无家可归人群已变得越来越困难。

ex.en: Volunteers were trained to assist elderly residents who live alone with shopping and household repairs.
ex.zh: 志愿者们接受了培训，以协助独居老人购物和修理家用设施。

ex.en: The refugees received immediate assistance from the Red Cross and local volunteers.
ex.zh: 难民们得到了红十字会和当地志愿者的紧急援助。

ex.en: Senior engineers are always willing to provide technical assistance to new staff.
ex.zh: 资深工程师总是乐于为新员工提供技术协助。

ex.en: The programme offers financial assistance to students from low-income families.
ex.zh: 该项目向低收入家庭的学生提供经济资助。

ex.en: She has worked as a personal assistant to the chief executive for five years.
ex.zh: 她担任首席执行官的私人助理已有五年。

ex.en: The professor hired two graduate students as research assistants.
ex.zh: 教授聘请了两名研究生担任研究助理。

ex.en: Ask the shop assistant whether this coat comes in a larger size.
ex.zh: 问问店员这件外套有没有更大号的。

phrases.m: 参加到……中去;对……公开表示赞同(或支持)

associate.usage: be associated with 与…有关。；反义: dissociate；v.联想，联系；混在一起 n.同事，伙伴 adj.副的，准的；as（作为）+soci（联想成social“社会的，社交的”）+ate（动词后缀，使）→使作为社会的一员→融入社会，和社会保持“联系”；词根：as+soci(同伴)+ate→同伴

ex.en: I always associate the smell of baking with my childhood.
ex.zh: 一闻到烘烤食物的味道，我就想起了童年。

ex.en: We unconsciously associate fast food with speed and impatience and carry those impulses into whatever else we're doing.
ex.zh: 我们不自觉地把快餐与速度、不耐烦联系起来，并且将那样的冲动带到我们在做的其他任何事情当中。

ex.en: Researchers associate regular physical exercise with a lower risk of depression among middle-aged adults.
ex.zh: 研究人员将中年人经常进行体育锻炼与较低的抑郁风险联系起来。

phrases.p: the National Association of Colleges and Employers

association.usage: n.协会，社团；联系；①协会；②交往(2009年翻译)：教育是附带发生的，但它并非人们交往的直接原因；索引p403

ex.en: The National Teachers' Association has called for smaller classes and higher salaries for experienced staff.
ex.zh: 全国教师协会呼吁缩小班级规模，并为有经验的教师提高薪资。

ex.en: The study found a strong association between sleep quality and memory performance in elderly people.
ex.zh: 该研究发现老年人的睡眠质量与记忆表现之间存在密切联系。

ex.en: Her association with the charity began twenty years ago when she volunteered at a local shelter.
ex.zh: 她与该慈善机构的结缘始于二十年前，当时她在一家当地收容所做志愿者。

ex.en: Memory is largely associative: a single smell can recall an entire childhood scene.
ex.zh: 记忆在很大程度上是联想性的：一种气味就能唤起整段童年场景。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

ex.en: The booming economy seems to have done little to assuage this underlying generational sense of anxious urgency, especially for those who have college debt.
ex.zh: 蓬勃发展的经济似乎并没有缓解这一代人潜在的紧迫感，尤其是对那些背负大学债务的人来说。

assume.usage: assuming that 假定。assumption 假定；承担。；词根 sum（拿）→拿来当真的→假设。近义：suppose vt. 假设；postulate 的近义词；v.假定、假设、具有、承担；v.假定，假设，认为；装出；呈现；他一再地（as）起诉（su）我（me），为什么？他“假设”我有罪啊！派生：assum

ex.en: It's probably safe to assume (that) we'll be hearing more about this story.
ex.zh: 可以肯定的是，我们会听到更多关于这个故事的消息。

ex.en: Aaron Norris assumes that many children's views on real estate are influenced by the media.
ex.zh: 亚伦·诺里斯认为很多孩子对房地产的看法受到了媒体的影响。

ex.en: "Many young people assume a great deal of personal responsibility for educating themselves and actively seeking out opposing viewpoints," the survey concluded.
ex.zh: 该调查总结道："很多年轻人对进行自我教育抱有很强的责任感，并积极寻求反面意见。"

assumption.usage: [族] assume vt. 假定；assume 的派生词；索引p403

ex.en: They are based on wrong assumptions.
ex.zh: 它们基于错误的假设。

ex.en: On the assumption that they will become relevant later, you make a mental note of discourse entities as well as possible links between them.
ex.zh: 你假设各个语篇实体在后文中是相互关联的，并在阅读时留意各个语篇以及它们之间可能存在的关联。

ex.en: The whole plan rests on the assumption that demand will keep rising.
ex.zh: 整个计划建立在需求将持续上升的假设之上。

ex.en: A single false assumption about consumer behaviour weakens the entire argument.
ex.zh: 关于消费者行为的一个错误假设削弱了整个论证。

assurance.usage: assure 的派生词。近义：insurance n. 保险；典型考题give him our__that选D.assurance;confidence信心;guarantee保证(书);insurance保险；n.把握；(人寿)保险；保证， 确保；assure 的派生词；索引p403

ex.en: The manager gave us a firm assurance that the project would be completed before the deadline.
ex.zh: 经理向我们明确保证，项目将在截止日期前完成。

ex.en: She answered every question with quiet assurance, which impressed all the interviewers present.
ex.zh: 她沉着自信地回答了每一个问题，给在场的所有面试官留下了深刻印象。

ex.en: The government's assurance that food safety standards would not be lowered failed to calm the public.
ex.zh: 政府关于食品安全标准不会降低的保证未能平息公众的担忧。

senses: v. 使确信，保证，确保；弄清
assure.usage: assure sb that 向某人保证；ensure 确保。；同义ensure,insure,guarantee;assured adj.有保证的;自信的；v.向……保证；确保，使确定；as(一再地)+sure(确信)→一再地确信→保证，使确信；索引p403

ex.en: Let me assure you that I will try to help you.
ex.zh: 我向你保证，我会尽力帮你。

ex.en: The Biotechnology Industry Organisation (BIO), a trade group, assured members that this was just a "preliminary step" in a longer battle.
ex.zh: 生物科技产业组织(BIO)是一个商业性团体，向其成员保证，这只是一场长期斗争的开始。

ex.en: Doctors assured the anxious family that the operation was routine and the risks were extremely small.
ex.zh: 医生们让焦虑的家属确信，手术是常规手术，风险极小。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

ex.en: Scientists monitor large asteroids closely because even a small one could devastate a city.
ex.zh: 科学家密切监测大型小行星，因为即使是一颗小行星也可能毁灭一座城市。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

ex.en: Air pollution has been linked to a sharp rise in childhood asthma.
ex.zh: 空气污染与儿童哮喘发病率急剧上升有关。

senses: vt. 使吃惊，使十分惊讶

phrases.m: adj. 令人惊讶的,惊人的
n. 惊讶,令人惊讶的事物

astonish.usage: astonishing 令人惊讶的。；同义surprise,amaze,shock；a(一)+ston(联想stone石头)+is(是)+h(形似椅子)→石头像椅子，太让人惊讶→使十分惊讶；索引p403

ex.en: The survey results astonished even the most experienced market analysts.
ex.zh: 调查结果连最资深的市场分析师也大为惊讶。

ex.en: It astonished the villagers that the old bridge survived the flood untouched.
ex.zh: 令村民惊讶的是，那座老桥在洪水中竟完好无损。

ex.en: She astonished the audience by playing the violin at the age of four.
ex.zh: 她四岁便拉小提琴，令观众惊叹不已。

senses: adj. 令人十分惊讶的；使人大为惊奇的；难以置信的
adj. 令人十分惊讶的；难以置信的

ex.en: The team made an astonishing discovery: the ancient text had been misread for a century.
ex.zh: 该团队有了一个惊人的发现：这份古代文献已被误读了一个世纪。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

ex.en: The new telescope captured astounding images of galaxies billions of light years away.
ex.zh: 这架新望远镜拍摄到了数十亿光年外星系的惊人图像。

ex.en: The root 'astro/aster' means 'star', as in 'astronomy' and 'asteroid'.
ex.zh: 词根 astro/aster 意为“星星”，见于 astronomy（天文学）和 asteroid（小行星）。

ex.en: Becoming an astronaut requires years of training and exceptional physical fitness.
ex.zh: 成为宇航员需要多年的训练和非凡的身体素质。

ex.en: The astronomer discovered a comet that returns roughly every seventy years.
ex.zh: 这位天文学家发现了一颗大约每七十年回归一次的彗星。

ex.en: The project eventually overran its budget by an astronomical margin.
ex.zh: 该项目最终的预算超支数额惊人。

ex.en: Advances in astronomy depend heavily on increasingly powerful telescopes.
ex.zh: 天文学的进步在很大程度上依赖日益强大的望远镜。

ex.en: She developed an interest in astronomy after visiting the planetarium.
ex.zh: 参观天文馆后，她对天文学产生了兴趣。

ex.en: Ancient farmers used astronomy to predict the seasons for planting.
ex.zh: 古代农民利用天文学来预测播种的季节。

senses: prep. 在（某处）；在（某时间或时刻）

ex.en: Unemployment peaked at nearly ten percent before the recovery finally began.
ex.zh: 失业率在复苏最终开始前达到近百分之十的峰值。

ex.en: The researchers selected participants at random to avoid bias in the sample.
ex.zh: 研究人员随机抽取参与者，以避免样本出现偏差。

senses: 表人，名词词性；表动作，动词词性；表有……性质的，形容词词性

ex.en: The suffix '-ate' forms verbs such as 'activate' and nouns such as 'advocate'.
ex.zh: 后缀 -ate 可构成动词（如 activate 激活）和名词（如 advocate 拥护者）。

ex.en: A professional athlete must balance intense training with adequate rest and nutrition.
ex.zh: 职业运动员必须在高强度训练与充分的休息和营养之间取得平衡。

senses: adj. 体育运动的；健壮的

ex.en: Regular athletic training improves both physical strength and mental discipline.
ex.zh: 经常进行体育锻炼能同时增强体力和意志力。

senses: 表行为、状态、由行为而产生的事物，名词词性

ex.en: The suffix '-ation' turns verbs into nouns, as 'communicate' becomes 'communication'.
ex.zh: 后缀 -ation 将动词变为名词，如 communicate 变为 communication。

senses: 表有……性质的，形容词词性

ex.en: The suffix '-ative' forms adjectives such as 'creative' and 'informative'.
ex.zh: 后缀 -ative 构成形容词，如 creative（有创造力的）和 informative（信息丰富的）。

ex.en: The Atlantic Ocean separates the Americas from Europe and Africa.
ex.zh: 大西洋将美洲与欧洲和非洲隔开。

ex.en: This type of lighting creates a relaxing atmosphere.
ex.zh: 这种类型的照明创造了一种放松的氛围。

ex.en: These men wrote and published extensively, reaching both New World and Old World audiences, and giving New England an atmosphere of intellectual earnestness.
ex.zh: 这些人大量地写作、出书，读者遍布新大陆和旧大陆，这给新英格兰带来了热衷学术的氛围。

ex.en: The earth's atmosphere shields living things from harmful solar radiation.
ex.zh: 地球大气层保护生物免受有害的太阳辐射。

ex.en: The hotel tries hard to create a friendly, family atmosphere.
ex.zh: 这家酒店努力营造亲切的家庭氛围。

senses: a. 大气层的；令人激动的；使人动感情的

ex.en: Rising carbon dioxide levels are altering atmospheric conditions across the globe.
ex.zh: 二氧化碳含量上升正在改变全球的大气状况。

atom.usage: 发音类似阿童木→阿童木别名原子小金刚→原子；拓展：the splitting of the atom 原子的分裂

ex.en: Two atoms of hydrogen combine with one atom of oxygen to form a molecule of water.
ex.zh: 两个氢原子和一个氧原子结合组成一个水分子。

senses: 表做……工作的人，名词词性

ex.en: The suffix '-ator' denotes a person who does something, as in 'creator' and 'navigator'.
ex.zh: 后缀 -ator 表示做某事的人，如 creator（创造者）和 navigator（领航员）。

senses: v. 使成为一部分,使附属,使依附;使喜爱,使依恋
attach.usage: attachment 附件；依恋。；v.系上，贴上；附上；认为…… 具有；与……有关联；at（表示“加强”）+tach（钉；钉子）→牢牢钉上→附上。；索引p403

ex.en: We attach great importance to good design of buildings and neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 我们非常重视建筑和社区的良好设计。

ex.en: They just want Ottawa to fork over additional billions with few, if any, strings attached.
ex.zh: 他们只想让渥太华额外再给几十亿加元，且没有（或只有很少的）附带条件。

ex.en: Please attach a recent photograph to the application form before you submit it online.
ex.zh: 在网上提交申请表之前，请在表上贴一张近期照片。

senses: n. 依恋；（电子邮件）附件；（机器）附加装置
attachment.usage: 串词记忆:总是黏在一起(attach)就是依恋(attachment)；索引p403

ex.en: The email contained an attachment that installed harmful software once it was opened.
ex.zh: 这封电子邮件包含一个附件，一旦打开就会安装有害软件。

attack.usage: v.抨击；侵害；袭击，攻击； 进攻 n.（疾病）发作；进攻；袭击， 攻击；损害，伤害；发音类似"a(一辆)坦克"→一辆坦克可以用来"攻击，袭击"

ex.en: They found the least defended area and attacked.
ex.zh: 他们找到了防守最薄弱的地区并发动了攻击。

ex.en: The minister's tax plan came under fierce attack from opposition parties.
ex.zh: 部长的税收计划遭到反对党猛烈抨击。

ex.en: The army launched its attack before dawn and had taken the port by noon.
ex.zh: 军队在黎明前发起进攻，到中午便攻占了港口。

ex.en: Doctors warned that he might suffer another heart attack without surgery.
ex.zh: 医生警告说，如果不做手术，他可能再次心脏病发作。

ex.en: The defender managed to block the attacker in the final minute of the match.
ex.zh: 防守队员在比赛最后一分钟成功挡住了进攻者。

senses: vt. 进入，达到（某种状态或情况）
vt.（通常经过努力）获得，得到
attain.usage: attain指经努力达到（水平、年龄等）。；at-（向）+tain（拿）→拿到→达到。近义：achieve vt. 达到，实现；记：at-(加强)+tain(握)→将某物努力握住→获得；[族]attainable a.可获得的；[近]acquire vt.获得；v.获得，实现；达到；at（表示“一再地”）+tain（=

ex.en: attain sociable traits
ex.zh: 获得社交特征

ex.en: Students with high hope set themselves higher goals and know how to work to attain them.
ex.zh: 有高期望的学生为自己设定了更高的目标，并知道如何努力实现这些目标。

ex.en: Few developing countries have attained the goal of universal primary education within a single decade.
ex.zh: 很少有发展中国家能在短短十年内实现普及初等教育的目标。

ex.en: Educational attainment varies widely across different income groups.
ex.zh: 不同收入群体的教育成就差异很大。

attempt.usage: v.努力，尝试 n.试图，努力；企图杀害；尝 试；at(表示加强)+tempt(引诱)→一直去引诱→尝试，试图

ex.en: She never attempted to explain her behaviour to her family.
ex.zh: 她从未试图向家人解释自己的行为。

ex.en: The company made no serious attempt to reduce its carbon emissions last year.
ex.zh: 该公司去年没有认真尝试减少碳排放。

ex.en: Rescuers attempted to reach the trapped miners before nightfall.
ex.zh: 救援人员试图在夜幕降临前到达被困矿工处。

ex.en: Her first attempt at the driving test ended in failure, but she passed a month later.
ex.zh: 她第一次尝试驾照考试以失败告终，但一个月后通过了。

attend.usage: attendance 出席。；at（一再地）+tend（延伸）→课堂上一再地延伸手臂=举手→积极“参加”。；索引p403

ex.en: We'd like as many people as possible to attend.
ex.zh: 我们希望出席的人越多越好。

ex.en: Over three hundred delegates attended the conference on urban transport held in Shanghai last month.
ex.zh: 上个月有三百多名代表出席了在上海举行的城市交通会议。

ex.en: In many rural areas, children have to walk for miles to attend the nearest primary school.
ex.zh: 在许多农村地区，孩子们必须步行数英里去上最近的小学。

attendance.usage: n.出席人数；出席，参加；索引p403

ex.en: The theatre has broken attendance records for three years in a row.
ex.zh: 这家剧院已连续三年打破了上座率的纪录。

ex.en: Attendance at these lectures is compulsory for all first-year students.
ex.zh: 所有一年级学生必须出席这些讲座。

ex.en: Average attendance at this season's home matches has fallen by a fifth.
ex.zh: 本赛季主场比赛的平均观众人数下降了五分之一。

ex.en: The school keeps a careful record of each pupil's attendance.
ex.zh: 学校仔细记录每个学生的出勤情况。

senses: n. 服务员,值班员,护理人员
attendant.usage: n.服务人员；侍从，随从 adj.伴随的，随之产生的；索引p403

ex.en: Flight attendants are trained to handle emergencies calmly.
ex.zh: 空乘人员接受过冷静处理突发状况的训练。

ex.en: The museum attendant guided visitors to the exhibition hall.
ex.zh: 博物馆的接待员引导参观者前往展厅。

ex.en: Rapid urbanisation brings attendant problems such as congestion and pollution.
ex.zh: 快速城市化带来了拥堵和污染等随之而来的问题。

attention.usage: 另：attract one's attention引起某人的注意；public attention公众关注；索引p403

ex.en: Many people are actually perfectly willing to talk—and may even be flattered to receive your attention.
ex.zh: 许多人其实完全愿意交谈——甚至可能因为得到你的关注而感到荣幸。

ex.en: The safety report attracted considerable attention from the media.
ex.zh: 这份安全报告引起了媒体的广泛关注。

ex.en: Constant notifications make it hard for students to sustain attention.
ex.zh: 不断弹出的通知使学生难以保持注意力。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

senses: adj. 注意的;专心的;体贴的;殷勤的
attentive.usage: adj.注意的，专心的；贴心的；索引p403

ex.en: An attentive listener notices far more than the words themselves.
ex.zh: 专注的倾听者注意到的远不止话语本身。

ex.en: The nurses were attentive to every detail of the patients' needs.
ex.zh: 护士们对病人需求的每个细节都体贴入微。

ex.en: Attentive readers will spot the contradiction in the second paragraph.
ex.zh: 细心的读者会发现第二段中的矛盾之处。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

ex.en: Numerous satisfied customers attest to the durability of the company's products.
ex.zh: 众多满意的顾客证明了该公司产品的耐用性。

ex.en: A positive attitude towards failure helps students learn from mistakes.
ex.zh: 对失败持积极态度有助于学生从错误中学习。

ex.en: Public attitudes towards genetic engineering have shifted over the past decade.
ex.zh: 在过去十年里，公众对基因工程的态度发生了转变。

ex.en: Employers value candidates who show a cooperative attitude.
ex.zh: 雇主看重表现出合作态度的求职者。

ex.en: The defendant's attorney argued that the search had been unlawful.
ex.zh: 被告的律师辩称这次搜查是非法的。

ex.en: Consult an attorney before signing any long-term contract.
ex.zh: 签署任何长期合同之前请咨询律师。

ex.en: The district attorney decided to bring charges against the company.
ex.zh: 地区检察官决定对该公司提起诉讼。

senses: vt. 吸引；引起……的好感（或爱慕）；招引
v. 吸引,招引,引起(注意等)
attract.usage: attractive 有吸引力的。；at-(去)+tract(拉)→拉过来→吸引；[族] attraction n. 吸引力；attractive a. 吸引人的；v.吸引；引起；at（表示“加强”）+tract（拽，拉）→一再地拽→吸引。；索引p403

ex.en: All the key words in the article are printed in bold type so as to attract readers' attention.
ex.zh: 文章中所有的关键词都是用粗体字印刷的，以吸引读者的注意。

ex.en: When Microsoft bought task management app Wunderlist and mobile calendar Sunrise in 2015, it picked two newcomers that were attracting considerable buzz in Silicon Valley.
ex.zh: 微软在2015年收购了任务管理应用Wunderlist和移动日历应用Sunrise，它们都是当时在硅谷引起相当大轰动的新公司。

ex.en: The city's low living costs and mild climate have attracted a growing number of young professionals.
ex.zh: 这座城市低廉的生活成本和温和的气候吸引了越来越多的年轻专业人士。

senses: n. 吸引；向往的地方；有吸引力的事

ex.en: The restored old harbour has become the city's most popular tourist attraction.
ex.zh: 修复后的老港口已成为该市最受欢迎的旅游景点。

senses: a. 吸引人的；有魅力的
adj. 吸引人的,有吸引力的,动人的
attractive.usage: 辨析：attractive 指女子、物体或景色等美好可爱；beautiful 修饰人时指容貌美,多形容女子；handsome 指男子英俊、女子身材俊美；pretty 指青年女子或小孩俊俏标致,语气不如 beautiful 强；adj.吸引人的；迷人的，有魅力 的；索引p403

ex.en: Overtime is not attractive to this generation.
ex.zh: 加班对这一代人来说没有吸引力。

ex.en: The company offers an attractive salary package to graduates with strong mathematical backgrounds.
ex.zh: 该公司为数学功底扎实的毕业生提供有吸引力的薪资待遇。

ex.en: Solar power has become increasingly attractive to investors as the cost of panels continues to fall.
ex.zh: 随着太阳能电池板成本持续下降，太阳能发电对投资者变得越来越有吸引力。

ex.en: The attractiveness of the job lies mainly in its flexible working hours.
ex.zh: 这份工作的吸引力主要在于其弹性工作时间。

ex.en: Nearly half of the decline in sales is attributable to the economic downturn.
ex.zh: 销售额下降近一半可归因于经济低迷。

phrases.m: 把某事归因于某人/某物

attribute.usage: 名词读音ˈætrɪbjuːt。；at-(去)+tribut(给予)→把原因归结给→归因；contribute 是贡献，attribute 是归因；to A attribute B = attribute B to A。近义：owe...to... 把……归功于……；v. 把… … 归因于；认为 是……所作 n.属性，特

ex.en: Some experts attribute the stress-reducing, health-related benefits of hugging to the release of oxytocin, often called "the bonding hormone" because it promotes attachment in relationships, including that between mother and their newborn babies.
ex.zh: 一些专家将拥抱可减轻压力、促进健康的好处归因于催产素的释放,催产素通常被称之为"亲密激素",因为它能促进人际关系中的依附感,包括母亲与新生儿之间的依附感。

ex.en: They appeared to possess all the attributes of a ruling class.
ex.zh: 他们似乎具有统治阶级的一切特征。

ex.en: Over time, the attributes of greatness shifted.
ex.zh: 随着时代的变迁，"伟大"的属性也发生了改变。

attributes.usage: n.属性 v.认为……属于；把……归 咎于

ex.en: Employers value attributes such as reliability and teamwork as much as technical skills.
ex.zh: 雇主对可靠性和团队合作等素质的重视不亚于专业技能。

ex.en: The attribution of the anonymous painting to Rembrandt remains highly controversial.
ex.zh: 将这幅匿名画作归为伦勃朗所作仍有很大争议。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

senses: adj. 熟悉的;适应的;(对特定声音)敏感的

ex.en: Good teachers are attuned to the individual needs of their students.
ex.zh: 优秀的教师能敏锐体察学生的个体需求。

ex.en: The root 'auct' means 'to increase', as in 'auction', where bidding keeps rising.
ex.zh: 词根 auct 意为“增加”，如 auction（拍卖），其中竞价不断升高。

ex.en: He auctioned all his collection of stamps.
ex.zh: 他把他收集的所有邮票都拍卖掉了。

ex.en: The painting was sold at auction for a record price of nine million dollars.
ex.zh: 这幅画在拍卖会上以九百万美元的创纪录价格售出。

ex.en: The family decided to auction the estate after the owner's death.
ex.zh: 主人去世后，家人决定拍卖这处房产。

ex.en: Bidders pushed the antique desk far beyond its estimated value.
ex.zh: 竞买者们把这张古董书桌的价格抬到远超其估价。

ex.en: The auctioneer opened the bidding at two million pounds.
ex.zh: 拍卖师以两百万英镑起拍。

audience.usage: audience强调集体时谓语用单数。；audi(听)+ence(名词后缀)→听的人→听众

ex.en: "Artists help scientists reach a broader audience and make emotional connections that enhance learning," one respondent said.
ex.zh: 一位受访者说“艺术家帮助科学家接触到更多的受众，并建立感情联系，增强学习效果。”

ex.en: The museum is trying to attract a wider audience.
ex.zh: 这家博物馆正试图吸引更多观众。

ex.en: The speaker adjusted his language to suit a non-specialist audience.
ex.zh: 演讲者调整了自己的语言以适应非专业听众。

senses: adj. 音频的，听觉的，声音的

ex.en: The app combines audio commentary with interactive maps to guide visitors around the ruins.
ex.zh: 这款应用将语音解说与互动地图相结合，引导游客参观遗址。

ex.en: An independent audit revealed serious weaknesses in the charity's bookkeeping.
ex.zh: 一次独立审计揭示了该慈善机构簿记中的严重缺陷。

ex.en: All public companies must undergo an annual audit.
ex.zh: 所有上市公司都必须接受年度审计。

ex.en: The tax authority will audit firms with unusually low reported profits.
ex.zh: 税务机关将对申报利润异常低的企业进行查账。

senses: n. 听众席，观众席；(美)礼堂
auditorium.usage: audit(听)+or(表示"人")+ium(名词后缀，表示"地点、场所")→有听众的地方→礼堂，会堂

ex.en: The new building will include an exhibition hall, auditorium, bookshop and restaurant.
ex.zh: 这座新楼里将有展厅、礼堂、书店和餐厅。

ex.en: Graduation ceremonies are held in the university auditorium.
ex.zh: 毕业典礼在大学礼堂举行。

ex.en: The auditorium seats more than a thousand people.
ex.zh: 这座礼堂可容纳一千多人。

ex.en: The final results of the study will be published in late Aug.
ex.zh: 这项研究的最终结果将在八月下旬公布。

ex.en: augment human labor
ex.zh: 使人类劳动力更强大

ex.en: She augmented her income by taking on freelance design work.
ex.zh: 她通过承接自由设计工作来增加收入。

ex.en: The hospital augmented its staff during the flu season.
ex.zh: 流感季节期间，医院扩充了工作人员。

ex.en: The festival, held every August, draws performers from more than thirty countries.
ex.zh: 这项每年八月举行的活动吸引了来自三十多个国家的表演者。

senses: n. 姑母；姨母；伯母；婶母；舅母

ex.en: My aunt, a retired teacher, volunteered to tutor children in the remote village.
ex.zh: 我的姑妈是一位退休教师，她自愿为偏远村庄的孩子们辅导功课。

ex.en: The listening test assesses aural comprehension of everyday English.
ex.zh: 听力测试考查对日常英语的听觉理解能力。

books.unit: 附录 I 部分国家(或地区)名称及相关信息

ex.en: Australia has introduced strict laws to protect its unique wildlife.
ex.zh: 澳大利亚已出台严格法律以保护其独特的野生动物。

books.unit: 附录 I 部分国家(或地区)名称及相关信息

ex.en: Austria is renowned for its long-standing contributions to classical music.
ex.zh: 奥地利以其对古典音乐源远流长的贡献而闻名。

senses: adj. 真正的，真迹的，真实的
adj. 真实的；真正的；可靠的；逼真的
authentic.usage: 记：本身为词根，意为“真的”→真实的；authen（联想成 author 作者）+tic（联想成挑出）→能挑出哪个是作者的真迹→真迹的；索引p403

ex.en: I don't know if the painting is authentic.
ex.zh: 我不知道这幅画是不是真迹。

ex.en: Kids need a range of authentic role models—as opposed to members of their clique, pop stars and vaunted athletes.
ex.zh: 孩子需要各种真实的榜样——而非他们小圈子里的人，或者流行歌手和那些众人吹捧的运动员。

ex.en: Experts confirmed that the manuscript was authentic.
ex.zh: 专家们证实这份手稿是真迹。

ex.en: Tourists increasingly demand authentic local food rather than imported fast food.
ex.zh: 游客越来越要求地道的当地食物，而不是进口快餐。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

senses: v. 证明……是真实的;确认……的真实性
vt. 证明…是真实的；鉴定

ex.en: The system might use a smart identity card, or a digital credential linked to a specific computer, and would authenticate users at a range of online services.
ex.zh: 该系统可能使用智能身份证或者连接到某台特定计算机的数字证书，从而在一系列在线网络服务中验证用户的真实身份。

author.usage: n.作者；作家 v.撰写，写作

ex.en: The author of the report warned against over-optimistic forecasts.
ex.zh: 该报告的作者告诫人们不要做出过于乐观的预测。

ex.en: Her first novel established her as a major contemporary author.
ex.zh: 她的第一部小说确立了她在当代重要作家中的地位。

ex.en: Authors increasingly publish their works directly through online platforms.
ex.zh: 作家们越来越多地通过网络平台直接发表作品。

senses: adj. 权威性的；命令式的；专断的
authoritative.usage: adj.专断的，命令式的；可信 的，权威的；索引p403

ex.en: She began to resent his authoritative manner.
ex.zh: 她开始讨厌他的权威态度。

ex.en: The journal is regarded as an authoritative source on climate science.
ex.zh: 该期刊被视为气候科学方面的权威来源。

ex.en: An authoritative tone does not in itself make an argument correct.
ex.zh: 专断的口吻本身并不能证明论点正确。

authority.usage: 复数authorities表示当局。；n.权威例为2020年翻译；索引p403

ex.en: And one leading authority says that these intensely powerful mental events can be not only harnessed but actually brought under conscious control.
ex.zh: 一位重要的权威人士说，这些异常重要的精神活动不仅可以被控制，而且在实际中可以有意识地被控制。

ex.en: It turned from God and the authority of the Roman Catholic Church and instead favoured a more humanistic approach to being.
ex.zh: 它（指文艺复兴时期）脱离了上帝，不再囿于罗马天主教会的权威，而更倾向于以人为本。

ex.en: The local health authority ordered all schools in the district to close.
ex.zh: 当地卫生当局下令关闭该地区所有学校。

ex.en: She lectures with great authority on the economy of ancient Rome.
ex.zh: 她讲授古罗马经济时极具权威。

ex.en: The project cannot proceed without written authorization from the board.
ex.zh: 没有董事会的书面批准，该项目无法进行。

ex.en: Payment authorization is required before any refund can be processed.
ex.zh: 在处理任何退款之前都需要付款授权。

ex.en: The official acted beyond his authorization when he signed the agreement.
ex.zh: 这名官员签署协议时超越了授权范围。

ex.en: Only the head of department can authorize payments above ten thousand dollars.
ex.zh: 只有部门主管才能批准一万美元以上的付款。

ex.en: The auto industry is shifting rapidly toward electric vehicles.
ex.zh: 汽车工业正迅速转向电动汽车。

ex.en: 'Auto' is simply a short form of 'automobile', the standard American term for a car.
ex.zh: auto 是 automobile 的简写，automobile 是美式英语中汽车的标准说法。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

autobiography.usage: n.自传；自传体写作；拆分记忆: auto(自己)+biography(传记)→自传；索引p403

ex.en: In his autobiography, the physicist recalls his years of wartime research.
ex.zh: 在这部自传中，这位物理学家回忆了自己战时研究的岁月。

ex.en: The retired footballer is writing his autobiography with a professional ghost writer.
ex.zh: 这位退役足球运动员正与职业代笔人合写自传。

ex.en: Her autobiography reveals the quiet sacrifices behind her sporting success.
ex.zh: 她的自传揭示了体育成功背后默默的牺牲。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

ex.en: The factory plans to automate its packaging process next year.
ex.zh: 工厂计划明年使其包装工序自动化。

ex.en: Firms that automate routine tasks can redirect workers to creative roles.
ex.zh: 将常规任务自动化的公司可以把员工转向创造性岗位。

ex.en: It is expensive to automate a factory that was built decades ago.
ex.zh: 将几十年前建造的工厂自动化成本很高。

senses: adj. 自动的,无意识的,机械的
automatic.usage: automate 使自动化。；派生 automatically adv. 自动地；adj.自动的；无意识的，不假 思索的 n.自动换挡汽车；真 automatic behavior 无意识行为；automatic self-defence 无意识的自我防卫；索引p403

ex.en: The factory gates are automatic and open as each truck approaches.
ex.zh: 工厂大门是自动的，卡车一靠近就会打开。

ex.en: Breathing is an automatic process controlled by the brain stem.
ex.zh: 呼吸是由脑干控制的无意识过程。

ex.en: Membership brings automatic admission to all national museums.
ex.zh: 成为会员即可自动获得所有国立博物馆的入场资格。

ex.en: The system automatically backs up all files at midnight.
ex.zh: 系统会在午夜自动备份所有文件。

automation.usage: [族] automate vt. 使自动化；索引p403

ex.en: Automation has already replaced thousands of routine jobs on the factory floor.
ex.zh: 自动化已经取代了工厂车间数千个常规岗位。

ex.en: The report predicts that automation will create almost as many jobs as it destroys.
ex.zh: 报告预测，自动化创造的就业岗位几乎与它摧毁的一样多。

ex.en: Full automation of the assembly line absorbed two years of the firm's profits.
ex.zh: 流水线的全面自动化耗去了该公司两年的利润。

ex.en: The automobile industry is under growing pressure to phase out petrol engines entirely.
ex.zh: 汽车工业正面临日益增大的压力，需要彻底淘汰汽油发动机。

ex.en: The region's economy depends heavily on the automotive industry.
ex.zh: 该地区的经济严重依赖汽车工业。

ex.en: The coming use of autonomous vehicles, for example, poses thorny ethical questions.
ex.zh: 例如，即将付诸使用的无人驾驶汽车就带来了棘手的道德伦理问题。

senses: n. 自治，自治权；自主，自主权
autonomy.usage: autonomous 自治的。；派生 autonomous adj. 自治的,自主的；auto（自主的，自动的）+nomy（形似economy）→经济上自主的→自治权，自治。

ex.en: The Act granted limited autonomy to the republics.
ex.zh: 该法案赋予各共和国的自治权是有限的。

ex.en: The region was granted greater autonomy over its tax policy.
ex.zh: 该地区在税收政策上获得了更大的自治权。

ex.en: Teachers need professional autonomy to adapt lessons to their students.
ex.zh: 教师需要职业自主权来因材施教、调整课程。

ex.en: The autopsy revealed that the cause of death was heart failure.
ex.zh: 尸检表明死因是心力衰竭。

ex.en: In autumn, tourists flock to the mountains to see the changing leaves.
ex.zh: 秋天，游客们涌向山区观赏红叶变幻的景色。

ex.en: 'Autumn' is the British term for the season that Americans usually call 'fall'.
ex.zh: autumn 是英式说法，美国人通常称这个季节为 fall。

auxiliary.usage: subsidiary指并存附庸事物;auxiliary指辅助性支援(auxiliary troops后备部队);secondary表从属附加因素;反义chief

ex.en: The hospital keeps an auxiliary power supply in case of sudden outages.
ex.zh: 医院备有一套辅助供电系统，以防突然断电。

senses: v. 使用某事物,利用某事物
n. (一般用于否定句或疑问句中)效用,利益,帮助
v. 有帮助；有益；有用；利用
avail.usage: without avail 徒劳无功;反义hinder v.妨碍,阻扰；拓展: of little/no avail 没有什么用处；没有用

ex.en: To avail all these benefits, just register online.
ex.zh: 要想得到所有这些好处，就在线注册吧。

ex.en: His protests were of no avail; the construction went ahead.
ex.zh: 他的抗议无济于事，工程照常进行。

ex.en: Students should avail themselves of every opportunity to practise speaking.
ex.zh: 学生应当利用一切机会练习口语。

senses: n. 可接近；效用；可得性
availability.usage: available 的派生词；n.可用性，可得性；空闲，闲暇；n.可用性，可得性；空闲；n.可得性例为2011年阅读；索引p403

ex.en: The widespread availability of such recordings has thus brought about a crisis in the institution of the traditional classical concert.
ex.zh: 这种唱片的普及也因此给传统古典音乐会的演出模式带来了危机。

ex.en: The availability of cheap renewable energy is transforming manufacturing.
ex.zh: 廉价可再生能源的可获得性正在改变制造业。

ex.en: Doctors worry about the limited availability of mental health services in rural areas.
ex.zh: 医生们担心农村地区心理健康服务的可获得性有限。

senses: adj. 可获得的；可用的；有空的
available.usage: available不置于名词后修饰人时指有空的。availability 可用性。；availability 的词基词；available可利用的,有效的;accessible容易接近的,可进入的;attainable可达到的,可得到的；adj.可用的，可获得的；有空的；avail 的派生词；adj.可获得例为2019

ex.en: Local officials are using the levers that are available to them to safeguard residents' health in the face of a serious threat.
ex.zh: 面对严重的威胁，地方官员正在利用他们可用的手段来保护居民的健康。

ex.en: Today, we live in a world where GPS systems, digital maps, and other navigation apps are available on our smartphones.
ex.zh: 如今，我们生活在这样一个世界：全球定位系统、电子地图以及其他导航应用在我们的智能手机上随时可用。

ex.en: Detailed information about the scholarship is available on the university's official website.
ex.zh: 有关该奖学金的详细信息可在大学官方网站上获取。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

ex.en: The expedition was forced to turn back after an avalanche blocked the mountain pass.
ex.zh: 雪崩封住了山口，探险队被迫折返。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

ex.en: The gallery is known for exhibiting avant-garde works that challenge artistic conventions.
ex.zh: 这家美术馆以展出挑战艺术常规的前卫作品而闻名。

ex.en: 'Ave' is the written abbreviation of 'Avenue', as in the address 'Park Ave'.
ex.zh: ave 是 Avenue（大街）的书写缩写，如地址 Park Ave（公园大道）。

senses: n. 大街；林荫大道；选择

ex.en: The avenues of the city were crowded with people.
ex.zh: 城里大街上挤满了人。

ex.en: Researchers are exploring new avenues for treating the disease.
ex.zh: 研究人员正在探索治疗这种疾病的新途径。

ex.en: The bookstore occupies a corner on one of the city's busiest avenues.
ex.zh: 这家书店坐落在该市最繁忙的大街之一的街角。

average.usage: 反义maximum n.最大(数);minimum n.最小(数)；索引p403

ex.en: The average household income in the region has risen by a third.
ex.zh: 该地区家庭平均收入增长了三分之一。

ex.en: On average, commuters in the capital spend two hours a day travelling.
ex.zh: 首都的通勤者平均每天花费两小时在上下班路上。

ex.en: The film was no more than an average production with a predictable plot.
ex.zh: 这部电影只是一部情节老套的平庸之作。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

senses: adj. 反对的;不愿意的;嫌恶的

ex.en: Many investors are averse to risk and prefer safer assets such as government bonds.
ex.zh: 许多投资者厌恶风险，更青睐国债等更安全的资产。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

ex.en: She has a deep aversion to speaking in front of large audiences.
ex.zh: 她对在大庭广众之下发言深怀反感。

senses: vt. 转移(目光、注意力等)
avert.usage: a-（离开）+vert（转）→转开→避免。近义：avoid vt. 避免；[记] a-（离开）+vert（转）→转开；辨析：avert 意为防止、避免(不愉快的事发生)、转移(视线)；avoid 意为回避、逃避、消除；a（一再地，加强）+vert（转，转变）→一再地转→转移目光；避免

ex.en: He managed to avert the closure of the factory.
ex.zh: 他设法使工厂免于倒闭。

ex.en: Swift international action averted a full-scale financial crisis.
ex.zh: 迅速的国际行动避免了一场全面的金融危机。

ex.en: She averted her eyes from the disturbing scene in the film.
ex.zh: 她把目光从电影中令人不安的场景上移开。

ex.en: The pandemic caused the deepest crisis in the history of commercial aviation.
ex.zh: 这场疫情造成了商业航空史上最严重的危机。

ex.en: Stricter aviation safety rules were introduced after the disaster.
ex.zh: 灾难发生后，更严格的航空安全规定出台了。

ex.en: Rising fuel costs remain a major challenge for the aviation industry.
ex.zh: 燃油成本上升仍是航空业面临的主要挑战。

senses: vt. 避免；防止；躲避；回避；避开
avoid.usage: 后接动名词。；avert 的近义词；avoid通常是有意识、成功地避开有害或不愉快的东西;avert意思更强烈,一般指避免重大事故；辨析：表示有意或作为一种行为的自动或偶然的结果而远离某物或避免做某事

ex.en: Until now, many sellers that have a physical presence in only a single state or a few states have been able to avoid charging sales taxes when they ship to addresses outside those states.
ex.zh: 此前，许多只在一个州或少数几个州拥有实体经营场所的销售商，当他们把货物运到那几个州以外的地方时，都能避免缴纳销售税。

ex.en: To avoid misunderstandings, put the agreement in writing.
ex.zh: 为避免误解，请把协议写成书面形式。

ex.en: Drivers are advised to avoid the city centre during the marathon.
ex.zh: 建议驾驶员在马拉松比赛期间避开市中心。

ex.en: The company's tax avoidance scheme was heavily criticised in the media.
ex.zh: 该公司的避税方案受到媒体的猛烈批评。

ex.en: Negotiators warned that difficult decisions still await the two sides next month.
ex.zh: 谈判代表警告说，下个月仍有艰难的决定等待着双方。

awake.usage: 同义①wake up②awaken,arouse③realise;反义sleep v.睡觉；索引p403

ex.en: Coffee taken late at night can keep you awake until dawn.
ex.zh: 深夜喝咖啡会让人一直清醒到天亮。

ex.en: The noise from the construction site kept the whole neighbourhood awake.
ex.zh: 工地的噪音使整个街区的居民都无法入睡。

ex.en: She was barely awake when the phone rang at five in the morning.
ex.zh: 清晨五点电话响起时，她几乎还没有睡醒。

ex.en: There are upsetting parallels today, as scientists in one wave after another try to awaken us to the growing threat of global warming.
ex.zh: 科学家们前仆后继地努力唤醒我们对全球变暖带来的日益严重的威胁的认识，与此同时，现在出现了诸多令人不安的类似情形。

senses: vt. 给予,授予(奖品等),奖励,判给
award.usage: award与reward辨析：award授予；reward报酬。；同义give,grant;reward,prize；a(一个)+ward(联想成word“单词”)→下课了老师多讲一个单词，作为认真听课的奖励→奖品；索引p403

ex.en: A town of culture award could become an annual event.
ex.zh: 文化小镇奖可以成为一年一度的活动。

ex.en: She won the best actress award at this year's international film festival.
ex.zh: 她获得了今年国际电影节的最佳女演员奖。

ex.en: The university awarded him an honorary doctorate for his public service.
ex.zh: 大学因其公共服务授予他荣誉博士学位。

ex.en: The injured worker was awarded substantial compensation by the court.
ex.zh: 法院判给这名受伤工人巨额赔偿。

senses: adj. 意识到…的；觉察到的
aware.usage: awareness 意识；unaware 未意识到的。；a（一个）+war（战争）+e→一个经历过战争的人“知道”和平的重要性→知道的，明白的。；串词记忆:察觉到(aware)所以很在意(care);易混词辨析:conscious指注意到或意识到某事物,通常作表语,常后接of或that从句,也指思想、记忆等有意识的;a

ex.en: They are less aware of the value of their money.
ex.zh: 他们很少意识到他们的钱的价值。

ex.en: We are aware of and take responsibility for the impact the fashion industry has on body ideals, especially on young people.
ex.zh: 我们意识到了时尚行业对理想身材的影响，尤其是给年轻人带来的影响，我们对此负有责任。

ex.en: Most consumers are now aware of the environmental harm caused by single-use plastics.
ex.zh: 现在大多数消费者已经意识到一次性塑料对环境造成的危害。

ex.en: Moral awareness matters in editing a newspaper.
ex.zh: 编辑报纸时道德意识很重要。

senses: ad. （时间或空间上）离开（某距离）；去别处
adv. 离开,远离,……掉,不断……下去

ex.en: The festival is only two weeks away, yet tickets remain largely unsold.
ex.zh: 距活动仅剩两周，然而门票大部分仍未售出。

senses: vt. 使某人敬畏或惊惧
awe.usage: awesome 令人敬畏的；极好的。；发音类似“哦”→太“惊叹”了，只能一直说“哦”→惊叹。

ex.en: He speaks of her with awe.
ex.zh: 他谈到她时肃然起敬。

ex.en: The visitors were struck with awe by the scale of the canyon.
ex.zh: 峡谷的宏大规模令游客们心生敬畏。

ex.en: New technologies often inspire both awe and anxiety.
ex.zh: 新技术常常既令人敬畏又令人焦虑。

ex.en: The view from the summit was absolutely awesome at sunrise.
ex.zh: 日出时从峰顶看到的景色令人叹为观止。

senses: adj. 糟糕的；可怕的；（数量）极大的
a. 很坏的；很多的；可怕的
adj. 极度的,极坏的,糟糕的

ex.en: The problem with being a grownup is that there's an awful lot of serious stuff to deal with.
ex.zh: 作为一个成年人的问题是，有很多重要的事情要处理。

ex.en: The team played an awful first half and fell behind early.
ex.zh: 球队上半场踢得很糟糕，早早落后。

ex.en: An awful smell from the factory alarmed the nearby residents.
ex.zh: 工厂散发的难闻气味令附近居民感到不安。

senses: adj. 尴尬的；笨拙的；难用的
adj. 令人尴尬的；难处理的；笨拙的；不舒适的
awkward.usage: adj.令人尴尬的；难处理的；笨 拙的；发音类似“拗口word”→在很多人面前把单词读得很拗口时感觉很尴尬→令人尴尬的；索引p403

ex.en: If you feel awkward being humorous, you must practice so that it becomes more natural.
ex.zh: 如果你在幽默时感到很别扭，你应该进行练习，使它变得更自然。

ex.en: Awkward or wordy phrasing or unclear sentences and paragraphs should be mercilessly poked and prodded into shape.
ex.zh: 要坚决找出那些拗口和啰嗦的措辞以及表达不清的句子和段落，然后改出个样子来。

ex.en: The new evidence placed the minister in an extremely awkward position before the parliamentary committee.
ex.zh: 新证据使这位部长在议会委员会面前陷入了极为尴尬的境地。

ex.en: The cafe installed a retractable awning to shade customers from the summer sun.
ex.zh: 咖啡馆安装了可伸缩的遮阳篷，为顾客遮挡夏日阳光。

senses: n. 裁减,解雇,倒闭,被停业
v. 大量削减,精简,砍掉,取消,解雇

ex.en: The company announced plans to ax hundreds of jobs at its factories.
ex.zh: 该公司宣布计划在旗下工厂大量裁减数百个岗位。

senses: n. (pl. axes) 轴,轴线,中心线
n. 中枢,轴心(国与国之间的联盟)

ex.en: The Earth rotates on an axis tilted at an angle of about twenty-three degrees.
ex.zh: 地球绕一根约倾斜二十三度的轴自转。

ex.en: She earned a BA in economics before joining the investment bank.
ex.zh: 她在入职这家投资银行前取得了经济学文学学士学位。

ex.en: The study tracked baby monkeys to observe how attachment forms in early life.
ex.zh: 这项研究通过追踪幼猴来观察依恋如何在生命早期形成。

bachelor.usage: 发音类似“掰扯了”→他刚和女朋友闹掰了，回归了单身→单身汉；拓展：a Bachelor of Arts / Engineering / Science 文学士/工程学士/理学士；索引p403

ex.en: He was 38, and a confirmed bachelor.
ex.zh: 他38岁了，是个独身主义者。

ex.en: Bachelor's degree
ex.zh: 学士学位

ex.en: He remains a bachelor, devoting all his energy to medical research.
ex.zh: 他一直单身，把全部精力投入到医学研究中。

ex.en: She completed her bachelor's degree in economics two years early.
ex.zh: 她提前两年完成了经济学学士学位。

senses: n. 背部；背面；后面；末尾
adv. 以前；向后；恢复原状 adj. 背后的；过去的

ex.en: One problem with the PreCheck program is the government's reluctance to back it.
ex.zh: 预检项目面临的一个问题是：政府不愿为其提供支持。

ex.en: Several major investors have agreed to back the startup financially.
ex.zh: 几家大型投资机构已同意为这家初创公司提供资金支持。

ex.en: There is a small garden at the back of the house.
ex.zh: 房子后面有一个小花园。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

senses: n. (舞台的)背景幕布;周围景物;(事件的)背景
n. （事态或活动的）背景；（舞台的）背景幕布

ex.en: Soon after Sketches by Boz appeared, a publishing firm approached Dickens to write a story in monthly installments, as a backdrop for a series of woodcuts by the then-famous artist Robert Seymour, who had originated the idea for the story.
ex.zh: 在《博兹札记》出版后不久，一家出版公司找到狄更斯，请他为当时著名的艺术家罗伯特·西摩创作的一系列木版画按月撰写背景故事，故事的想法源于罗伯特·西摩。

senses: vi. 产生事与愿违的不良（或危险）后果

ex.en: "Whether you're a politician or a parent, it might be helpful to keep in mind that trying to maintain eye contact may backfire if you're trying to convince someone who has a different set of beliefs than you," said Minson.
ex.zh: 明森说道：“不论你是政治家还是父母，牢记下面这一点或许很有用：如果你在尝试说服与你观点不同的人，保持眼神交流可能会适得其反。”

senses: n. 个人背景资料(学历,资历等)
background.usage: back(背后)+ground(场地)→背后的场地→背景；索引p403

ex.en: One more reason not to lose sleep over the rise in oil prices is that, unlike the rises in the 1970s, it has not occurred against the background of general commodity-price inflation and global excess demand.
ex.zh: 油价上涨不会导致失眠的另一个原因是，与20世纪70年代不同，这次油价上涨不是发生在物价普遍上涨及全球需求过旺的背景之下。

ex.en: Applicants from a poor background receive extra support during admission.
ex.zh: 出身贫寒的申请人在录取过程中会得到额外支持。

ex.en: She has a solid background in both computer science and finance.
ex.zh: 她在计算机科学和金融两个领域都有扎实的背景。

ex.en: The talks took place against the background of a sharp economic slowdown.
ex.zh: 会谈是在经济急剧放缓的背景下进行的。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

ex.en: The court system faces a huge backlog of cases caused by staff shortages.
ex.zh: 由于人手短缺，法院系统面临大量积压的案件。

senses: adj. 向后的,倒行的；落后的
backward.usage: backwards美式兼用；know backward了如指掌。；back(后面的)+ward(朝……方向)→向后的;反义:forward adv.向前；adj.向后的，朝后的；倒退的； 落后的 adv.向后，朝后；倒退地

ex.en: The economy took a backward step after the trade dispute.
ex.zh: 贸易争端之后，经济出现了倒退。

ex.en: He leaned backward to avoid the falling branch.
ex.zh: 他向后仰身躲避掉落的树枝。

ex.en: Investing little in education keeps a country backward in technology.
ex.zh: 对教育投入过少会使一个国家的技术落后。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

ex.en: The children spent the whole afternoon playing games in the backyard.
ex.zh: 孩子们整个下午都在后院做游戏。

ex.en: Nutritionists warn that eating processed meats such as bacon daily may raise health risks.
ex.zh: 营养学家警告说，每天食用培根等加工肉类可能会增加健康风险。

ex.en: Neither chilling nor freezing kills all bacteria.
ex.zh: 冷藏和冷冻都不能杀死所有的细菌。

ex.en: Harmful bacteria can spread quickly through improperly stored food.
ex.zh: 有害细菌会通过储存不当的食物迅速传播。

ex.en: Some bacteria in the soil help plants absorb nutrients.
ex.zh: 土壤中的一些细菌能帮助植物吸收养分。

senses: adj. 低劣的,拙劣的；不舒服的,有病的
bad.usage: too bad不幸的,糟糕的;go from bad to worse越来越糟;辨析:bad意思最广泛;evil和wicked指道德上存在问题或本质不好;ill较弱,主要用于成语

ex.en: The report condemned the bad working conditions in several overseas factories.
ex.zh: 报告谴责了几家海外工厂恶劣的工作条件。

senses: adj. 易怒的，爱发脾气的

ex.en: The manager was so bad-tempered that few employees dared to make suggestions.
ex.zh: 这位经理脾气很坏，几乎没有员工敢提建议。

ex.en: Wearing a security badge is required in all research laboratories.
ex.zh: 所有研究实验室都要求佩戴安全徽章。

senses: ad. 拙劣地；不成功地；未能令人满意；严重地
adv. 恶劣地,严重地；非常
badly.usage: 比较级worse，最高级worst。；bad(严重的)+ly(副词后缀)→严重地

ex.en: Small businesses were badly hit by the sudden rise in energy prices.
ex.zh: 中小企业因能源价格突然上涨而遭受重创。

ex.en: Playing badminton regularly can improve reflexes and overall cardiovascular health.
ex.zh: 定期打羽毛球可以提高反应能力和整体心血管健康。

ex.en: Shoppers are encouraged to bring a reusable bag instead of buying plastic ones.
ex.zh: 鼓励购物者自带可重复使用的袋子，而不是购买塑料袋。

ex.en: Passengers waited almost an hour for their baggage after the delayed flight landed.
ex.zh: 晚点航班降落后，乘客们等了将近一个小时才取到行李。

ex.en: The judge released the suspect on bail, citing weak evidence and strong family ties.
ex.zh: 法官以证据不足和家庭关系稳固为由准予嫌疑人保释。

senses: v. (在鱼钩上、陷阱中等)放诱饵
bait.usage: 助记:bait(放诱饵)wait(等待)鱼上钩;同义:lure；索引p403

ex.en: Conservationists used bait to lure the invasive species into specially designed traps.
ex.zh: 自然资源保护者用诱饵将入侵物种诱入特制的陷阱。

bake.usage: 辨析:bake在密封容器或锅上直接烘烤,不接触火;broil明火烤;burn烧焦;toast烘烤烤暖;同义roast

ex.en: Local bakeries bake bread fresh every morning before the market opens.
ex.zh: 当地面包店每天早晨在市场开市前现烤面包。

phrases.p: strike a balance between A and B

phrases.m: 保持平衡,稳定 / 失去平衡,慌乱

balance.usage: 发音类似"芭蕾思"→芭蕾舞者在跳舞时需要思考如何保持"平衡"；②vt.均衡为2013年新题型；索引p403

ex.en: Stop laughing: it's not just cost effective but helps you balance your diet.
ex.zh: 别笑了，这不仅省钱，还能帮你平衡饮食。

ex.en: It's not just cost effective but helps you balance your diet.
ex.zh: 这不仅仅划算，还能帮你均衡饮食。

ex.en: Cyclists must learn to keep their balance before riding on busy roads.
ex.zh: 骑车人必须先学会保持平衡，才能到繁忙的路上骑行。

ex.en: He struggles to balance a demanding job with evening classes.
ex.zh: 他艰难地在繁重的工作和夜校之间求得平衡。

ex.en: The apartment's small balcony offered a rare view over the crowded old town.
ex.zh: 这套公寓的小阳台难得地可以俯瞰拥挤的老城区。

senses: adj. 光秃的，秃顶的；不加赘述的；简单的
bald.usage: 派生baldness n.光秃；ba（爸爸）+ld（old老了）→爸爸老了会有些秃顶。

ex.en: He started going bald in his twenties.
ex.zh: 他二十几岁便开始谢顶。

senses: vt.&vi. 做成球状；使成团块

ex.en: The children rolled the ball across the grass while their parents watched nearby.
ex.zh: 孩子们在草地上滚球，父母们在一旁看着。

ex.en: She trained for ten years before joining a professional ballet company.
ex.zh: 她训练了十年才加入一家专业芭蕾舞团。

ex.en: The weather balloon transmitted data on temperature and pressure throughout its ascent.
ex.zh: 气象气球在整个上升过程中传输温度和气压数据。

ballot.usage: 助记:ballot(投票)选ballet(芭蕾舞)演员

ex.en: Voters will cast their ballot on the constitutional reform early next year.
ex.zh: 选民将于明年初就宪法改革进行投票。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

ex.en: The staircase's carved wooden balusters date from the eighteenth century.
ex.zh: 楼梯上雕刻的木质栏杆柱可追溯至十八世纪。

ex.en: Pandas survive almost entirely on a diet of bamboo.
ex.zh: 大熊猫几乎完全以竹子为食。

ban.usage: ban后接动名词。；辨析:ban法律禁止;forbid命人不做;prohibit依规章禁止;反义:permit；n.禁止，禁令 v.禁止，取缔；发音类似“颁”→颁布“禁令”。；ban 的过去式/过去分词同形 banned；banned books 禁书。；索引p403

ex.en: Calls to disassemble all telescopes on Mauna Kea or to ban future development there ignore the reality that astronomy and Hawaiian culture both seek to answer big questions about who we are, where we come from and where we are going.
ex.zh: 拆卸莫纳克亚山上所有天文望远镜或是禁止未来在莫纳克亚山继续开发的呼声其实忽略了一个重要事实,即天文学和夏威夷文化都是在试图回答我们是谁、我们从何处来、我们将去往何处等深奥问题。

ex.en: The law effectively bans smoking in all public places.
ex.zh: 该法律有效地禁止在所有公共场所吸烟。

ex.en: The city banned plastic bags in supermarkets.
ex.zh: 该市禁止超市使用塑料袋。

ex.en: And the ban on ultra-thin models seems to go beyond protecting models from starving themselves to death—as some have done.
ex.zh: 而且对超瘦模特的禁令似乎不仅仅是为了保护模特，使其避免(为追求瘦而将自己)饿死——一些模特已死于饥饿。

ex.en: Exports of banana and coffee account for most of the country's farm income.
ex.zh: 香蕉和咖啡出口占该国农业收入的大部分。

ex.en: A local band performed in the square to raise money for the flood victims.
ex.zh: 一支本地乐队在广场演出，为洪灾灾民筹款。

ex.en: Critics argue that the subsidy is merely a band-aid solution to a structural problem.
ex.zh: 批评者认为，这项补贴只是应对结构性问题的权宜之计。

ex.en: The nurse applied a fresh bandage to the wound before discharging the patient.
ex.zh: 护士在病人出院前为伤口换上了新绷带。

senses: n. 巨响 / v. 发出砰的一声
v. 发出砰的一声；(砰砰)猛击,猛撞
bang.usage: 音"砰"→巨响,发出砰的一声；助记:音“砰”→发出砰的一声;同义:slam,strike,hit；n.突然的巨响；重击，猛撞； 刘海 v.猛敲，砰然重击；很响地使 劲关上 adv.恰好，正好

ex.en: She heard the door bang shut behind her.
ex.zh: 她听到门在她身后砰地关上了。

ex.en: He banged on the table to silence the noisy crowd.
ex.zh: 他敲着桌子让喧闹的人群安静下来。

ex.en: The explosion ended with a loud bang heard miles away.
ex.zh: 爆炸以一声数英里外都能听到的巨响结束。

ex.en: The river burst its bank after days of heavy rain, flooding nearby farms.
ex.zh: 连日大雨后河水决堤，淹没了附近的农场。

ex.en: Investment bankers came under close scrutiny after the financial crisis.
ex.zh: 金融危机后，投资银行家受到密切关注。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

ex.en: Online banking has fundamentally changed the way people manage their money.
ex.zh: 网上银行从根本上改变了人们理财的方式。

bankrupt.usage: bankruptcy 破产。；[族]bankruptcy n. 破产；bank(银行)+rupt(打破)→银行被打破→破产的;派生bankruptcy n.破产；bank（银行）+rupt（=break“断裂”）→银行（资金）断裂→破产的。派生：bankruptcy

ex.en: Large numbers of builders, property firms and retailers have gone bankrupt.
ex.zh: 大量的建筑商、房地产公司和零售商已经破产。

ex.en: The airline went bankrupt after fuel prices doubled.
ex.zh: 燃油价格翻番后，这家航空公司破产了。

ex.en: Reckless expansion nearly drove the chain of stores bankrupt.
ex.zh: 盲目扩张几乎使这家连锁商店破产。

bankruptcy.usage: bankrupt 的派生词；词根记忆: bank(bench, 长凳)+rupt(break, 断裂)+cy→摆放货币的长凳被折断→破产；索引p403

ex.en: As the auctioneer called out bids, in New York one of the oldest banks on Wall Street, Lehman Brothers, filed for bankruptcy.
ex.zh: 就在拍卖师喊出报价之时，纽约华尔街上其中一家最古老的银行——雷曼兄弟——提出了破产申请。

ex.en: The firm filed for bankruptcy after failing to repay its debts.
ex.zh: 这家公司因无力偿还债务而申请破产。

ex.en: Bankruptcy laws are designed to give failed businesses a second chance.
ex.zh: 破产法旨在给倒闭的企业第二次机会。

ex.en: Protesters gathered outside the hall, carrying a banner demanding cleaner air.
ex.zh: 抗议者聚集在大厅外，举着要求净化空气的横幅。

banquet.usage: 助记:ban(禁止)+quet(音似quiet安静)→禁止安静的地方→宴会

ex.en: The university held a grand banquet to celebrate its centenary.
ex.zh: 这所大学举办盛大宴会庆祝建校一百周年。

ex.en: The palace's banqueting hall was decorated with portraits of former kings.
ex.zh: 王宫的宴会厅装饰着历代国王的画像。

bar.usage: behind bars 在狱中。；同义:rod,stick,counter,block,forbid;反义:admit；索引p403

ex.en: New laws bar tobacco companies from advertising at sports events.
ex.zh: 新法律禁止烟草公司在体育赛事上做广告。

ex.en: Poverty should never be a bar to higher education.
ex.zh: 贫困绝不应成为接受高等教育的障碍。

ex.en: They met at a small bar near the harbour.
ex.zh: 他们在港口附近的一家小酒吧相遇。

ex.en: The neighbourhood barbecue was postponed because of the sudden thunderstorm.
ex.zh: 由于突如其来的雷雨，社区的烧烤活动被推迟了。

ex.en: In many small towns, the barber's shop remains a place where locals exchange news.
ex.zh: 在许多小镇，理发店仍是当地人交流消息的场所。

senses: adj. 赤裸的；光秃的；仅有的
bare.usage: barely 仅仅；几乎不。；同义:naked,bald；在酒吧（bar）喝多了，赤裸（bare）着脚回家。；索引p403

ex.en: I got in the habit of going around with bare feet.
ex.zh: 我养成了赤脚走路的习惯。

ex.en: The workers handled the frozen metal pipes with their bare hands.
ex.zh: 工人们徒手搬运冰冷的金属管。

ex.en: The hillside lay completely bare after the summer wildfires.
ex.zh: 夏季野火过后，山坡变得光秃秃的。

ex.en: The article gives only the bare facts of the scandal.
ex.zh: 这篇文章只提供了丑闻的最基本事实。

senses: adv. 赤裸裸地,无遮蔽地;空空地
adv. 仅仅；刚刚；勉强可能
barely.usage: 辨析:hardly几乎没有;scarcely不足刚刚够;barely勉强达到,仅仅刚好；adv.勉强才能；几乎不；刚刚； 仅仅；索引p403

ex.en: During their six- to twelve-week voyage, they survived on barely enough food allotted to them.
ex.zh: 在六到十二周的航行中，他们靠分配给他们的食物勉强维持生计。

ex.en: Another urge or need that these gardens appear to respond to, or to arise from, is so intrinsic that we are barely ever conscious of its abiding claims on us.
ex.zh: 另一种冲动或需求是相当内在的，以至于我们几乎都意识不到它们存在于我们的内心。这些花园就是对这些冲动或需求的回应，或者说它们就源于这种冲动或需求。

ex.en: He had barely arrived home when the storm cut off electricity across the whole neighborhood.
ex.zh: 他刚到家，暴风雨就切断了整个街区的电力供应。

phrases.m: 与某人就某事讨价还价

bargain.usage: bargain with sb.与...谈判;bargain away以廉价售出;同义:negotiate；发音类似“八根”→用八根木头达成一笔“交易”。；联想记忆：bar(音似"叭")+gain(获得)→小嘴叭叭不停地说以便获得自己喜欢的东西→讨价还价；索引p403

ex.en: The bargain is very pure.
ex.zh: 这种交易非常纯粹。

ex.en: The bargain is very pure: Employee puts in hours of physical or mental labor and employee draws out life-sustaining moola.
ex.zh: 这种交易非常纯粹：员工花费数小时的体力或脑力劳动以获得维持生计的金钱。

ex.en: At half the usual price, the plane tickets were a real bargain.
ex.zh: 票价只有平时的一半，这些机票真划算。

ex.en: The union bargained with management for a five percent pay rise.
ex.zh: 工会与资方谈判，要求加薪百分之五。

ex.en: The dog's loud bark alerted the owner to the smoke rising from the kitchen.
ex.zh: 狗的大声吠叫让主人察觉到厨房里升起的烟雾。

barn.usage: 辨析:barn主要贮谷物(美语)叫谷仓;store(英)=warehouse(美)仓库,范围更广;silo贮青饲料或谷物

ex.en: The old barn was converted into a studio where local artists exhibit their work.
ex.zh: 旧谷仓被改造成一间工作室，当地艺术家在这里展出作品。

barrel.usage: n.桶；枪管 v.飞奔，高速行驶

ex.en: Oil prices climbed steadily as a barrel of crude reached its highest level in months.
ex.zh: 随着一桶原油价格达到数月来的最高水平，油价稳步攀升。

senses: adj. 不生育的；不结果实的
adj. 贫瘠的，不毛的；不孕的
barren.usage: bar（酒吧）+ren（“人”）→天天泡酒吧可能影响怀孕→不孕的。

ex.en: He wants to use the water to irrigate barren desert land.
ex.zh: 他想用水来灌溉贫瘠的沙漠土地。

barrier.usage: 词组barrier cream护肤脂；barr（障碍）+ier（名词后缀）→障碍物。；化生为熟:bar(栏杆),参加校运会时,跑道两边用栏杆做障碍物,防止观众乱入跑道；索引p403

ex.en: Unfortunately, people create inner barriers with a help of exaggerating fears.
ex.zh: 不幸的是，人们通过夸大恐惧来制造内心的障碍。

ex.en: Language barriers often prevent skilled immigrants from finding jobs that match their qualifications.
ex.zh: 语言障碍常常使技术移民无法找到与其资历相匹配的工作。

ex.en: The government has removed trade barriers to encourage competition and reduce prices for consumers.
ex.zh: 政府取消了贸易壁垒，以鼓励竞争并降低消费者面临的价格。

senses: n. 基地,根据地;总部,大本营
base.usage: 串词记忆：这个 base（基数）是个小 case；索引p403

ex.en: Digital services include everything from providing a platform for selling goods and services online to targeting advertising based on user data, and the tax applies to gross revenue from such services.
ex.zh: 数字服务包括从提供在线销售商品和服务的平台到基于用户数据定向投放广告在内的一切服务，而税收适用于此类服务的总收入。

ex.en: The airline has moved its European base from Paris to Dublin.
ex.zh: 这家航空公司将其欧洲基地从巴黎迁到了都柏林。

ex.en: The film is loosely based on a true story from the 1970s.
ex.zh: 这部电影大致取材于二十世纪七十年代的一个真实故事。

ex.en: Consumer trust should be the base of every marketing strategy.
ex.zh: 消费者信任应当是一切营销策略的基础。

ex.en: Baseball remains popular in the region, though fewer young people follow the professional leagues.
ex.zh: 棒球在该地区仍然流行，但关注职业联赛的年轻人越来越少。

ex.en: The court ruled that the accusations against the journalist were baseless.
ex.zh: 法院裁定对这名记者的指控毫无根据。

senses: n. [常用sing.] 基准，基线；（网球场的）底线
n. 基准，基础；（网球场等的）底线
baseline.usage: n.基线，基准；组合词：base(基础)+line(线)→基础的线→底线；索引p403

ex.en: Researchers first measured the patients' baseline blood pressure.
ex.zh: 研究人员首先测量了患者的基准血压。

ex.en: The survey provides a baseline for judging future policy changes.
ex.zh: 这项调查为评判未来的政策变化提供了基准。

ex.en: Without baseline data, it is hard to measure educational progress.
ex.zh: 没有基准数据，就很难衡量教育方面的进步。

senses: n. 地下室;建筑物的底部

ex.en: Heavy rain flooded the basement, damaging boxes of documents stored there.
ex.zh: 大雨淹没了地下室，损坏了存放在那里的成箱文件。

senses: adj. 基本的,基础的;根本的
basic.usage: bas(e)(基础)+-ic→基础的；[族] basically；派生:basically adv. 基本上,根本上；索引p403

ex.en: Access to clean water is a basic human right.
ex.zh: 获得清洁的饮用水是一项基本人权。

ex.en: The course covers the basic principles of economics.
ex.zh: 这门课程讲授经济学的基本原理。

ex.en: Even a basic understanding of statistics helps readers assess news claims.
ex.zh: 即使对统计学的初步了解也能帮助读者评估新闻中的说法。

senses: ad. 基本上；从根本上说

ex.en: Basically, the plan aims to cut costs without reducing service quality.
ex.zh: 从根本上说，该计划旨在不降低服务质量的前提下削减成本。

ex.en: The Amazon basin contains roughly a tenth of the world's known species.
ex.zh: 亚马孙盆地拥有大约全球已知物种的十分之一。

basis.usage: 复数bases。；辨析:basis/ground/foundation多指抽象基础;base指具体有形基础,应用广；n.基础，要素；基准，方式；理 由，根据；bas(低，下；基础)+is(表性质)→基础；索引p403

ex.en: The basis of a good marriage is trust.
ex.zh: 美满婚姻的基础是信赖。

ex.en: Most respondents in the survey would go to the national parks on a regular basis.
ex.zh: 参与调查的大多数受访者都会定期去国家公园。

ex.en: The committee rejected the proposal on the basis that it lacked reliable scientific evidence.
ex.zh: 委员会以缺乏可靠科学证据为由否决了该提案。

ex.en: Each morning the market sellers filled a basket with fresh vegetables for regular customers.
ex.zh: 每天早晨，市场摊主都会为老顾客在篮子里装满新鲜蔬菜。

ex.en: He credits basketball with teaching him discipline and the value of teamwork.
ex.zh: 他认为是篮球教会了他自律和团队合作的价值。

ex.en: A single bat can consume thousands of insects in one night, protecting crops naturally.
ex.zh: 一只蝙蝠一晚上能吃掉数千只昆虫，从而自然地保护农作物。

senses: n. （人、物等的）一批，一组，一群
batch.usage: 归类:batch批 catch捉 hatch策划 match比赛 patch补丁 snatch夺得

ex.en: The laboratory tests each batch of vaccines before it is released to hospitals.
ex.zh: 实验室在每一批疫苗发放给医院之前都会进行检测。

ex.en: Doctors advised a warm bath before bedtime to improve the patient's sleep quality.
ex.zh: 医生建议睡前洗个温水澡，以改善患者的睡眠质量。

bathe.usage: 派生bather n.游泳者,浴疗者,海水浴者

ex.en: Warning signs advised tourists not to bathe in the river after the chemical spill.
ex.zh: 化学物质泄漏后，警告标志提醒游客不要在河里游泳。

ex.en: The hotel renovated every bathroom, replacing old fittings with water-saving devices.
ex.zh: 酒店翻新了每间浴室，用节水装置取代了旧设备。

battery.usage: batter(接连猛击)+y→能用炮弹接连猛击敌人的设施→炮台

ex.en: Engineers developed a battery that charges twice as fast and lasts far longer.
ex.zh: 工程师开发出一种充电速度快一倍且续航更久的电池。

battle.usage: 辨析:battle指大战役;fight最常用;war指全面大规模战争;skirmish小规模交火；bat=beat（打），那battle就是"战斗，斗争"；索引p403

ex.en: The Church's long-standing dogma was losing the great battle for truth to rationalists and scientists.
ex.zh: 在与理性主义者和科学家的"真理之战"中，教会长久以来坚持的教条输得一败涂地。

ex.en: Doctors are battling to save the sight of the injured driver.
ex.zh: 医生们正奋力保住受伤司机的视力。

ex.en: The team faces an uphill battle to stay in the top division.
ex.zh: 该队面临留在顶级联赛的一场硬仗。

ex.en: The museum documents the final battle of the civil war in vivid detail.
ex.zh: 博物馆以生动的细节记录了内战的最后一役。

senses: n. (海或湖的)湾;分隔间;(建筑物的)突出结构;栗色马
v. (尤指捕猎时)发出长嗥,低沉地吠叫;厉声强要
adj. 深棕色的,枣红色的

phrases.m: (猎物)被围困,被迫作困兽之斗
不让(敌人)接近;防止(问题恶化)

bay.usage: n.湾；间隔区；栗色马 v.连续嚎叫 adj.枣红色的，深棕色的

ex.en: The fishing boats returned to the bay before the storm arrived.
ex.zh: 渔船在暴风雨来临前返回了海湾。

ex.en: A nature reserve protects the birds that winter in the bay.
ex.zh: 一个自然保护区保护着在这个海湾越冬的鸟类。

ex.en: The hotel overlooks a sheltered bay popular with swimmers.
ex.zh: 这家酒店俯瞰着一个深受游泳者喜爱的避风海湾。

ex.en: The ruins are believed to date from about 300 BC.
ex.zh: 这些遗迹据信建于约公元前300年。

ex.en: To be effective, the new regulations must be enforced consistently across all provinces.
ex.zh: 新法规要发挥效力，就必须在所有省份一致执行。

ex.en: Volunteers cleaned the beach every weekend, collecting tons of plastic waste.
ex.zh: 志愿者们每个周末都清理海滩，收集数吨塑料垃圾。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

senses: n. 信标灯;灯塔;烽火;指引者

ex.en: For centuries the lighthouse served as a beacon for ships navigating the rocky coast.
ex.zh: 几个世纪以来，这座灯塔一直是船只驶过礁石海岸的指引信标。

ex.en: Darwin noticed that finches on different islands had differently shaped beaks.
ex.zh: 达尔文注意到，不同岛屿上雀鸟的喙形各不相同。

beam.usage: 辨析：beam 光柱、光束；glare 耀眼刺目的光、怒目而视；flare 闪光、短暂而摇曳的光；glimmer 闪烁的微光、柔和的光；索引p403

ex.en: A beam of sunlight pierced the dusty window.
ex.zh: 一束阳光穿透了布满灰尘的窗户。

ex.en: Steel beams support the roof of the new stadium.
ex.zh: 钢梁支撑着新体育场的屋顶。

ex.en: The old man beamed with pride as he watched his students graduate.
ex.zh: 老人看着学生们毕业，脸上洋溢着自豪的笑容。

ex.en: Farmers switched from corn to bean cultivation after demand for plant protein surged.
ex.zh: 在植物蛋白需求激增后，农民从种植玉米转向种植豆类。

bear.usage: can't bear to do/doing 忍受不了。过去式bore，过去分词borne。；bear(熊)beam(微笑)着吃 bean(蚕豆)；词组bear down on逼近,严惩;bear in mind记在心里;bear with忍受;bear up振作起来;支撑下去；v.承担；经得起；承受，容忍； 生育 n

ex.en: Both the absolute cost of healthcare and the share of it borne by families have risen.
ex.zh: 医疗的绝对成本以及其中需家庭自行承担的份额都增加了。

ex.en: She could hardly bear the pain in the weeks after the operation.
ex.zh: 手术后数周她几乎无法忍受疼痛。

ex.en: Shareholders, not taxpayers, should bear the risks of risky lending.
ex.zh: 承担高风险贷款风险的应是股东，而不是纳税人。

ex.en: The old wooden bridge cannot bear trucks heavier than forty tons.
ex.zh: 这座老木桥承受不了超过四十吨的卡车。

beard.usage: 辨析:beard下巴尖部胡须;moustache嘴唇上部鼻孔下边胡须;whisker沿下巴长到另一耳尖的连鬓胡子

ex.en: The witness described the suspect as a tall man with a grey beard.
ex.zh: 目击者描述嫌疑人是一个留着灰白胡须的高个子男人。
